heading.title: Appearance of parties and consequence of non-appearance

article.title: Procedure in case of non-attendance of one or more of several defendants.
article.content: Where there are more defendants than one, and one or more of them appear, and the others do not appear, the suit shall proceed, and the Court shall, at the time of pronouncing judgment, make such order as it thinks fit with respect to the defendants who do not appear.
article.html:
11Procedure in case of non-attendance of one or more of several defendants.

Order 9, Rule 11

Where there are more defendants than one, and one or more of them appear, and the others do not appear, the suit shall proceed, and the Court shall, at the time of pronouncing judgment, make such order as it thinks fit with respect to the defendants who do not appear.
